policy: Every markdown file under docs/superpowers/{plans,specs} must be classified here. entries = files that earn a place in the active tree (active: owned by an open issue; durable-reference: cited by source, tests or rules for rationale not restated there). deleted = delivered-stale | superseded | abandoned files removed from the tree; git history is the archive, and the guard fails if one reappears. Run `node scripts/docs-lifecycle.mjs refresh` to update issue-state snapshots; `check` is offline.
